questions.answer: We wrote their names, but they didn't read them.

questions.answer: The visitors talked a lot, but the sorrow has not ended.

questions.prompt: Afite amatwi, ariko ntiyumvise ibyo wamubwiye.
questions.answer: He has ears, but he didn't hear what you told him.

questions.prompt: Ntameze neza rwose, sinzi amaherezo ye uko azamera
questions.answer: She is not doing well at all; I don't know what the end will be for her.

questions.prompt: Babaye inzererezi zitagira aho ziba, ariko niringiye ko amagambo wababwiye azabafasha.
questions.answer: They have been wanderers without a place to live, but I hope that the words you told them will help them.

questions.prompt: Namusabye ngo mbimufashemo, kandi nizera ko Imana na yo izabimufashamo
questions.answer: I asked him so that I could help him concerning it, and I believe that God will also help him in it.

questions.prompt: Urakoze rwose; ndagushimye pe!
questions.answer: You've really helped; I thank you profoundly.

questions.prompt: Yaranditse kandi yaravuze, ariko ntacyo byamaze.
questions.answer: He wrote and he spoke, but to no avail.
